method:
Capture new style remixes and ten menu layouts from actual mGBA runs.

Inventory/resources, seed, safe position, visited flags and navigation are
explicit fixtures. UI pixels, drawing canvases, menu focus, animation phases
and poses are never assigned. All presentation comes from real game controls.

captures.name: layout-items
captures.note: Real Start opens the native study; full inventory is a fixture.

captures.name: layout-navigate
captures.note: Ordinary D-pad moves focus in this layout, including its own spatial navigation.

captures.name: layout-seeds
captures.note: Actual navigation selects ammunition tool; inspect name, useful prose and exact count.

captures.name: layout-bow
captures.note: Actual navigation selects ammunition tool; inspect name, useful prose and exact count.

captures.name: layout-assigned
captures.note: A/B/L assign the selected tool through actual controls.

captures.name: layout-map
captures.note: Actual generated overview map with Map/Astrolabe ownership fixtures.

captures.name: layout-map-navigate
captures.note: Ordinary map-cursor movement, with current-room marker distinct from the inspected room.

captures.name: layout-zoom-map
captures.note: A toggles the actual known-room detail map.

captures.name: layout-focus-return
captures.note: R returns to the same selected tool; no selection fixture.

captures.name: layout-hud-return
captures.note: Start closes the study and restores the live HUD with assigned equipment.

captures.name: layout-empty-items
captures.note: Disclosed empty-inventory fixture checks absence and layout stability.

captures.name: layout-empty-key-items
captures.note: Empty key-item page has explicit absence rather than invented progress.

captures.name: layout-fog-map
captures.note: Only the current room is visited; no Map/Astrolabe. Unknown room geometry must stay hidden.

captures.name: layout-fog-zoom
captures.note: Inspecting a fogged neighbor cannot disclose its generated terrain.

checks.name: all seven owned tools reachable through actual D-pad navigation
actual navigation restores initial inspected tool
ordinary A moves focused item to its button
ordinary B moves focused item to its button
ordinary L moves focused item to its button
ordinary D-pad reaches a different carried key item
key items cannot replace equipped tools
B returns from zoom to overview
selected map room survives page cycling
menu/map navigation preserves world, room and gameplay RNG
closing menu restores every static world VRAM tile
closing menu restores legal live animation allocations
closing menu restores every world BG palette bank
layout-hud-return HUD alpha stays in compact authorized regions
layout-hud-return ordinary idle keeps pace with VBlank
closing menu retains unique assigned tools
fog map does not fetch unknown-room geometry
fog inspection selects a different room

limits: Natural room navigation uses transition fixtures; no UI canvas/image/pose assignment. Authored complete art coverage and gameplay visual captures are separate evidence. No generic yes/no screen exists; actual shop/title choices are captured.

publication.note: Native frames/filmstrips/MP4 and exact-palette GIFs are unchanged copies. Raw all-frame sequences and quantized GIFs are archival.
